allow_large: The owner asked for this on 2026-10-02 (one explicit workers setting with three values, visible routing); six code files plus the tests and docs the contract change touches

amendments.because: The owner said on 2026-10-02 that Forge keeps no legacy: no one-time rewrite of codex to split
amendments.done_when: forge.toml's workers takes codex (every task and fix on Codex, user-facing included, using the design model's codex entry for user-facing work), claude (everything on Claude) or split (user-facing story tasks on Claude, the rest on Codex: today's behaviour). forge sync changes an existing workers = "codex" to "split" once, so an upgrade keeps behaviour and the file says it; new repos get split written explicitly. forge work prints one line before starting naming the worker, model and effort and why (for example 'Building PERMFLOW-1/T5 with Claude (claude-opus-5-5, high) because it is user-facing (workers = split)'), and forge next shows the worker beside each ready task. If the worker family changes between rounds of one item, the next forge work starts a fresh session on the new worker with the brief and the latest review findings. The skill and the AGENTS.md block explain the three values in one line each. Command-level tests cover each value for a user-facing task and a plain task, the sync rewrite, the printed line, and a family switch between rounds.

findings.body: Interrupt a Codex round during its capacity-retry wait, switch to Claude, then switch back to Codex. `src/forge/codex.py:376–377` records a pending retry before that wait. Switching to Claude skips recovery and calls this helper, which clears `conversation` but leaves `pending`. On switching back, `src/forge/codex.py:201–206` therefore attempts recovery using the now-null conversation ID. [Codex's thread/read contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/app-server-protocol/schema/json/v2/ThreadReadParams.json) requires a string ID, so subsequent Codex work refuses instead of starting fresh. Recover or safely retire the pending retry before discarding its conversation ID. The added interruption test covers startup before a conversation exists, which does not exercise this case.
findings.title: Preserve pending Codex recovery when forgetting a conversation

why: A story task marked user-facing always goes to a Claude worker even when forge.toml says workers = "codex", and nothing in forge.toml, forge next or forge work says so; the owner wants which agent builds what to be visible and switchable in one place
